SealedSubstitutionDecision.title: SealedSubstitutionDecision
SealedSubstitutionDecision.description: The sealed substitution decision record: immutable decision content (with the constraint-evaluation reference) plus its SHA-256 content digest.

SubstitutionId.title: SubstitutionId
SubstitutionId.description: Opaque substitution-request identity: "substitution:" followed by a lowercase slug.

TenantId.title: TenantId
TenantId.description: Opaque tenant identity: "tenant:" followed by a lowercase slug.

PoId.title: PoId
PoId.description: Opaque purchase-order identity: "po:" followed by a lowercase slug.

ConstraintEvaluationReference.title: ConstraintEvaluationReference
ConstraintEvaluationReference.description: The constraint-evaluation reference a substitution acceptance must carry: an opaque digest in the W004 policy-evaluation shape plus an optional opaque policy-shape reference.

OpaqueReference.title: OpaqueReference
OpaqueReference.description: Opaque, bounded, provider-neutral reference string owned by its producing system.

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (exactly three fractional digits, Z suffix).

PrincipalId.title: PrincipalId
PrincipalId.description: Opaque acting principal: "principal:" followed by a lowercase slug (W009 identity grammar).
